title: NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring AI safety failure rates and refusal behaviors by generating evidence-grounded synthetic queries conditioned on specific demographic attributes, such as race, ethnicity, and affected social groups.
Evaluating model safety guardrails and societal alignment using targeted synthetic prompts anchored in specific regional, national, and cultural contexts.

Segmenting and comparing model failure rates (e.g., medical advice non-disclosure or self-harm policy violations) across diverse occupational user personas, such as healthcare professionals, legal professionals, and caregivers.
